title: Velvet Double V Neck Maxi Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This Velvet Double V Neck Maxi Bridesmaid Dress exudes luxury and sophistication. The soft velvet fabric feels incredibly smooth against the skin, while the double V-neck design adds a modern, flattering touch. The flowing maxi length offers elegance and grace, making it the perfect choice for bridesmaids seeking a chic yet comfortable look for weddings or formal events.

Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Tea length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises velvet.

Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
